human_name: Chromosome 13 short-arm rDNA + flanking segmental duplications

CHM13.note: T2T-CHM13 v2.0 chr13 p-arm — 0 to centromere boundary (~16.5 Mb). rDNA array core at 5,817,416-9,348,041 (~3.53 Mb, 45S rDNA head-to-tail repeats of ~43 kb unit). The largest of the five human rDNA arrays. Coordinates from Nurk 2022, doi:10.1126/science.abj6987.

HPRC_pangenome_v1.1.note: HPRC v1.1 acrocentric pangenome — SAACs form an inter-chromosomal community per Guarracino 2023; chr13 PHR total 4.53 Mb. Per-haplotype coordinates vary.

copy_count_typical: ~80-300 rDNA copies in array; flanking SD blocks shared with chr14, chr21
architecture_note: GRCh38 chr13 p-arm is N-masked (~16 Mb of Ns) — entry is pangenome-only by necessity. T2T-CHM13 first provided complete sequence (Nurk 2022). SST1 array on 13p11.2 shares >99% pairwise identity with 14p11.2 and 21p11.2 in direct orientation (Guarracino 2023). A 630 kb SD ~1.6 Mb distal of SST1 array mediates ectopic chr13-chr21 recombination — proposed Robertsonian translocation mechanism.

rDNA_array.note: Largest of the five human rDNA arrays per Nurk 2022. CHM13 represents one haplotype; population variability is substantial — Hori 2024, Guarracino 2023 estimate 60-800 copies total across the 5 acrocentric arrays per cell

sst1_array.note: GC-rich, PRDM9-binding-motif enriched — recombination hotspot per Guarracino 2023

distal_sd_630kb.function: ectopic chr13-chr21 recombination breakpoint — candidate substrate for the most common (chr13;chr21) Robertsonian translocation

primary.note: rDNA array is intractable for unique mapping at the unit level — k=31, mm=2 with chain-context only. Disambiguation between acrocentric short arms (chr13/14/15/21/22) requires >99% identity SD context; for population variant calling, treat as multi-position by default.

fallback_chain.name: multi_position
fallback_chain.trigger: default — acrocentric SDs are not uniquely resolvable at the read level
fallback_chain.rationale: rDNA + SST1 + 630-kb SD all >99% identical across chr13/14/21 — multi-position is the honest output

fallback_chain.name: assembly_anchor
fallback_chain.rationale: p-arm SDs are tractable only with reads spanning ≥100 kb of SD context

fallback_chain.name: novel_haplotype_flag
fallback_chain.rationale: Robertsonian-translocation products create chimeric chr13-chr14 or chr13-chr21 acrocentric arms — flag explicitly

primary_sources.note: Nurk S et al., Science. The complete sequence of a human genome (T2T-CHM13 v2.0). rDNA array coordinates: chr13 5817416-9348041 (3.53 Mb).

Guarracino A et al., Nature. Recombination between heterologous human acrocentric chromosomes. PHR chr13 = 4.53 Mb; 13p11.2/14p11.2/21p11.2 SST1 array >99% identity; 630-kb SD 1.6 Mb distal of SST1 = Robertsonian breakpoint candidate.
Hoyt SJ et al., Science. From telomere to telomere: the transcriptional and epigenetic state of human repeat elements. Acrocentric satellite + SST1 characterisation.

supporting_databases: T2T-CHM13 v2.0 (marbl/CHM13 GitHub) — primary coordinate source
HPRC R2 pangenome (Liao 2023 + 2026 update) — inter-haplotype variability
